item.title: Typeface with historical link to hospitals and medical care
item.description:
Hello,

I’m working on a website for a scientific lab within an academic medical center, and I’d like to choose a typeface that has some historical link to hospitals or medicine. I’ll need typefaces for paragraphs of text as well as headings, and any references would be much appreciated!

Regards,
Jeff
